grammar.summary: 本课描述一场令人惊异的现代雕塑展，语法上突出 that 引导的同位语从句、被动语态（be surprised, be designed, had been magnetized）与现在分词作定语/状语（moving, suspended, lined up, fulfilling）。还出现 not only...but...as well 并列结构。

points.title: 同位语从句 (Appositive Clauses)
points.explanation: that 引导同位语从句，对抽象名词（idea, discovery 等）作内容解释，that 只起连接作用不作成分。本课 The idea that modern art can only be seen in museums 用 that 解释 idea 的具体内容。

examples.en: The idea that modern art can only be seen in museums is mistaken.
examples.cn: 那种认为现代艺术只能在博物馆里才能看到的观点是错误的。

points.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice)
points.explanation: be + 过去分词构成被动语态，突出承受者或客观事实。本课大量使用被动：were surprised（被震惊）、had been magnetized（被磁化）、seemed designed to shock（被设计来震惊），使展览的「被看」「被造」色彩突出。

examples.en: In spite of this, some people -- including myself -- were surprise by a recent exhibition of modern sculpture.
examples.cn: 尽管如此，最近举办的一次现代雕塑展览还是使一些人（包括我在内）大吃了一惊。

examples.en: These peculiar forms not only seemed designed to shock people emotionally, but to give them electric shocks as well!
examples.cn: 好像设计这些奇形怪状的展品不仅是为了给人感情上的强烈刺激，而且还想给人以电击似的！

points.title: 现在分词作定语与状语 (Present Participles as Modifiers)
points.explanation: 现在分词可作定语（修饰名词，表主动进行）或状语（表伴随）。本课 moving sculpture（活动雕塑）、suspended from the ceiling（悬挂着的）作定语；Lined up against the wall（靠墙排列着）作状语，使静态展品富于动感。

examples.en: The objects on display were pieces of moving sculpture.
examples.cn: 展品都是些活动的雕像。

examples.en: Oddly shaped forms that are suspended form the ceiling and move in response to a gust of wind are quite familiar to everybody.
examples.cn: 人们所熟悉的是悬挂在天花板上、造型奇特、随风飘荡的雕塑品。

examples.en: Lined up against the wall, there were long thin wires attached to metal spheres.
examples.cn: 靠墙排列着许多细长的电线，而电线又连着金属球。

exercises.q: The idea ______ modern art can only be seen in museums is mistaken.（同位语从句）
In spite of this, some people -- including myself -- ______ surprise by a recent exhibition of modern sculpture.（被动语态）
These peculiar forms not only seemed designed to shock people emotionally, ______ to give them electric shocks as well!
用现在分词填空：Lined up against the wall, there were long thin wires ______ to metal spheres.（写出 attach 的现在分词形式）
下列哪个词与课文中 peculiar 的含义最接近？
